get.description:
Retrieve paginated list of orders for admin users with comprehensive filtering options.

This endpoint provides a flexible query interface for administrators to search, filter,
and paginate through orders. It supports multiple filter criteria including status,
category, date ranges, order type classification, and user search.

Performance optimizations:
- Uses batch loading for related entities (user, accepted_by, service, order_status_doing)
- Implements single-query batch loading for chat room lookups to avoid N+1 queries
- Uses subqueries for aggregated data (offer counts, payment status)
- Caches enum values at module level to avoid recomputation

Args:
    status: Filter by order status (OrderStatusEnum values) or doing status (OrderStatusDoingEnum values)
    order_id: Filter by specific order ID (numeric string)
    order_title: Filter orders by title (case-insensitive partial match)
    search: Search orders by customer or freelancer full name (case-insensitive partial match)
    category: Filter by category ID
    direction: Filter by category direction (scientific_work, three_d, dizayn, web, document, marketing, seo_traffic, audio_video, business)
    order_type: Filter by order type classification:
        - 'ready_service': Orders for pre-defined services
        - 'custom_order': Custom orders not immediately accepted (accepted > 2 min after creation)
        - 'direct_order': Custom orders immediately accepted (accepted within 2 min or at creation)
    start_date: Filter orders created on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD format, inclusive)
    end_date: Filter orders created before this date (YYYY-MM-DD format, exclusive - adds 1 day)
    deadline_start_date: Filter orders with deadline on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD format, inclusive)
    deadline_end_date: Filter orders with deadline before this date (YYYY-MM-DD format, exclusive - adds 1 day)
    is_new: Filter by new order status (True for new orders, False for old orders)
    page: Page number for pagination (starts at 1)
    page_size: Number of items per page (1-100)
    db: Database session dependency
    current_user: Authenticated user (must be moderator or superadmin)
    
Returns:
    Dictionary containing:
        - count: Total number of orders matching the filters
        - orders: List of OrderListAdmin objects with order details
        
Raises:
    HTTPException 403: If user is not a moderator or superadmin
    HTTPException 400: If date format is invalid or order_type is invalid
    
Example:
    GET /admin/order-list?status=OPEN&page=1&page_size=20&start_date=2025-01-01&end_date=2025-01-31
